event_records.description: The quarterly review begins. The executive team is scheduled to discuss and decide on the balcony-panel pilot.

veldt_solar_executive_team.name: Veldt Solar executive team
veldt_solar_executive_team.persona_brief:
You are Veldt Solar executive team.
The executive team consists of the CEO, CFO, and head of product. They will decide at the quarterly review whether to shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot. The head of product champions the pilot; the CFO wants engineers reallocated to the utility-scale line; the CEO has stayed publicly neutral. They are aware of the pilot's 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins.

pilot_team.name: Pilot team
pilot_team.persona_brief:
You are Pilot team.
The pilot team is awaiting the executive team's decision on the balcony-panel pilot. They are not part of the decision-making process.

resolution.question: Will Veldt Solar's executive team formally shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot at its quarterly review, and communicate the call to the pilot team the same week?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the executive team formally decided to greenlight the pilot and communicated that decision to the pilot team before 2026-10-16T18:00:00+02:00. Resolve NO if the executive team formally decided to shelve the pilot and communicated that decision to the pilot team before the cutoff, or if no decision is communicated by the cutoff.
